```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(consort)
library(grid)
set_consort_defaults(txt_gp = gpar(cex = 0.8), parse_markup = TRUE)
```
Goal of this is to build a consort diagram using rstudio as I did not want to go through the trouble of drawing it by hand. 
```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=15}
# Cohort selection and final HIV classification
pretty_pic <-
  add_box(
    txt = "**Total Patients** (n=116,049,829)",
    text_width = 45
  ) |>

  add_side_box(
    txt = "*Patients without hospice admission* (n=114,073,843)",
    text_width = 45
  ) |>

  add_box(
    txt = "*Patients with hospice admission* (n=1,975,986)",
    text_width = 45
  ) |>

  add_side_box(
    txt = "Excluded^{1} (n=7):\n• Missing hospice admission date",
    text_width = 38
  ) |>

  add_box(
    txt = "*Patients with identifiable hospice admission date* (n=1,975,979)",
    text_width = 45
  ) |>

  add_side_box(
    txt = "Excluded^{2} (n=959,343):\n• Did not have 12 months of continuous MX CLOSED and RX CLOSED coverage before hospice admission",
    text_width = 38
  ) |>

  add_box(
    txt = "*Patients with 12 months of continuous MX and RX CLOSED coverage* (n=1,016,636)",
    text_width = 45
  ) |>

  add_side_box(
    txt = "Excluded^{3} (n=73,160):\n• Insurance coverage gaps or changes in MX/RX insurance groups during the 12 months before hospice admission",
    text_width = 38
  ) |>

  add_box(
    txt = "*Patients with constant MX and RX insurance groups during the 12 months before hospice admission* (n=943,476)",
    text_width = 45
  ) |>

  add_side_box(
    txt = "Excluded^{4} (n=28,006):\n• Younger than 50 years at hospice admission",
    text_width = 38
  ) |>

  add_box(
    txt = "*Patients aged 50 years or older at hospice admission* (n=915,470)",
    text_width = 45
  ) |>

  add_side_box(
    txt = "Excluded (n=6,088):\n• Incomplete 12-month pre-hospice diagnosis/procedure claims availability",
    text_width = 45
  ) |>

  add_box(
    txt = "*Patients with complete 12-month claims availability* (n=909,382)",
    text_width = 45
  ) |>

  add_side_box(
    txt = "*Excluded: missing or unknown required demographic/geographic information* (n=37,758)"
,
    text_width = 45
  ) |>

  add_box(
    txt = "**Final Eligible Hospice Cohort** (n=871,624)",
    text_width = 45
  ) |>

  # Aimee: final cohort split by HIV classification
  add_split(
    txt = c(
      "*HIV-Positive Hospice Patients* (n=2,364)",
      "*HIV-Algorithm-Negative Hospice Patients* (n=869,260)"
    ),
    text_width = 45
  )

plot(pretty_pic)
```




```{r}

# Save CONSORT diagram
png("images/consort_hiv_hospice.png",
    width = 3000, height = 2200, res = 300)

plot(pretty_pic)

dev.off()

```
